title.narrative: Global Opportunities for the Long-Term Development of the Artisanal and Small-Scale Gold Mining Sector in Costa Rica - planetGOLD Costa Rica

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The project aims to reduce mercury pollution and mitigate the environmental and social impacts of ASGM in Costa Rica. A key focus is on increasing the ASGM sector’s capacities. The design and implementation of an effective formalization mechanism will foster adequate conditions for the mining communities and miners, while enhancing their operational efficiency, ensuring environmental compliance, and improving market access for responsibly sourced gold. These elements ultimately will make Costa Rica’s ASGM sector cleaner, safer and more profitable.The project also encourages entrepreneurship by promoting an alternative livelihood strategy that seeks for economic diversification, while expanding income opportunities beyond mining. In parallel, this approach will be helpful to disincentivize illegal mining in restricted areas by law guaranteeing environmental protection in these areas.Formalization will create an enabling environment for miners to access to finance and to invest in safer, mercury-free technologies and upgrade their infrastructure, reducing occupational risks and improving worker safety and health. Additionally, the project emphasizes social cohesion and community participation, strengthening local governance in all target areas. It aims to promote inclusive decision-making, empower marginalized groups—especially women—through training, resource access, and equitable opportunities within the ASGM sector.These integrated efforts not only target mercury reduction and environmental conservation but also advance health, safety and income benefits in mining-affected communities across Costa Rica. To measure these impacts, which will vary depending on miners and organizations, complementarity with surrounding land uses and local economies, relevant socio-economic indicators have been incorporated into the project's results framework (refer to Appendix C).
